motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, always SIDEWAYS, never up or down the frame, never toward or away from the lens; ONE move per window, not a chain; every move starts by shoving off glass, gravel or furniture; he never lies, hovers or talks still; the lens is INSIDE the water a claw from him, the glass wall is the frame edge; HE fills two thirds of the frame height, legs in shot; a new tight shot size every window; the last frame still moves
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: THREE SERVANTS in livery beyond the glass; A LADY in white gloves, only her hands in shot
props: a blank cream price tag on a string; a huge glazed ham on a silver platter; a velvet stool
prop_continuity: the tag hangs on his small claw until 8.8, then on the ham; speech is heard, never shown
environment: inside a glass tank, water filling the frame, a rich salon with chandeliers blurred beyond the glass; gravel floor
lighting: bright chandelier light through the water

audio.language: Russian, verbatim, nothing added or repeated; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and unhurried, even 4.3 syllables per second

audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable
